stories.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
stories.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that generates an entire primitive in one forward pass. The layout adapts to the primitive's type, dimensionality, and length, supporting compact boxes and long, variable-length trajectories. Crucially, spatial accuracy need not require reproducing an autoregressive model's exact token sequence. VFlash therefore trains on annotated primitives and directly accepts structurally valid predictions without target-token agreement. Across the evaluated 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks, VFlash consistently reduces prediction errors relative to autoregressive decoding. Preliminary single-rollout measurements indicate approximately 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting. A world action model conditioned on VFlash plans achieves 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites, compared with 62.6% for the baseline.

why.en: VFlash shows spatial accuracy does not require reproducing an autoregressive model's token sequence: a lightweight drafter emits an entire primitive in one forward pass, cutting decoding cost while raising downstream success (62.6% to 70.2% on MolmoSpaces). Structured visual outputs merit their own decoding schemes, not token-by-token mimicry.
why.zh: VFlash 表明空间精度无需复现 autoregressive 的 token 序列：轻量 drafter 一次 forward 联合输出整个 primitive，既降延迟又把 MolmoSpaces 成功率从 62.6% 提到 70.2%，说明结构化视觉输出值得专用 decoding 方案。

where.en: Applies to vision-language models emitting structured visual plans (points, boxes, trajectories) for robotics and autonomous driving. Bounds: evidence covers 2D/3D trajectory tasks and four MolmoSpaces suites; the ~25x figure is preliminary single-rollout 3D point motion forecasting, not a language-decoding claim.
where.zh: 适用于输出视觉 plan（点、bounding box、trajectory）的 vision-language 模型，面向 robotics 与自动驾驶。Bounds：证据仅覆盖 2D/3D trajectory 任务与 MolmoSpaces 四个套件；25x 为 3D 点位预测的单次 rollout 初步测量，勿外推至语言 decoding。

stories.titleZh: VFlash：通过 Flash 基元解码快速、准确的视觉规划
stories.summaryZh: 机器人和自动驾驶等物理人工智能任务的模型不需要仅用语言进行推理。他们可以使用视觉计划——点、边界框和轨迹——来表示空间目标并预测运动。然而，自回归视觉语言模型一次生成一个坐标标记，从而使更丰富的预测成本越来越高。我们介绍 VFlash，这是一种通过 Flash 基元解码进行快速、准确的视觉规划的方法。 VFlash 利用视觉图元的已知结构来联合预测它们的坐标，使用轻量级绘图器在一次前向传递中生成整个图元。布局适应图元的类型、维度和长度，支持紧凑的盒子和长的、可变长度的轨迹。至关重要的是，空间准确性不需要再现自回归模型的精确标记序列。因此，VFlash 在带注释的基元上进行训练，并直接接受结构上有效的预测，而无需目标令牌协议。在评估的 2D 和 3D 机器人轨迹任务中，VFlash 始终减少了相对于自回归解码的预测误差。初步的单 rollout 测量表明 3D 点运动预测的生成速度提高了大约 25 倍。以 VFlash 计划为条件的世界行动模型在四个 MolmoSpaces 任务套件中取得了 70.2% 的平均成功率，而基线的成功率为 62.6%。

stories.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
stories.summary: SLA is a spatial-language-action model that continually pre-trains and post-trains a pretrained VLA policy with spatial alignment to a frozen 3D perception model, using feature-dependent gates and probabilistic state dropout to improve spatial understanding across diverse robot data while preserving inference architecture.

why.en: Continual pre-training lets a frozen 3D perception model inject spatial grounding into an already-trained VLA policy while preserving the inference architecture — a recipe for scaling spatial ability in robot policies without retraining from scratch or changing the deployed model.
why.zh: 通过持续预训练把冻结 3D 感知模型的空间对齐注入已有 VLA policy，且推理架构不变，为机器人策略的空间能力扩展提供了无需从头训练、也不改动推理端的路径。

where.en: Applies to VLA-based robot policies trained across diverse robot data where spatial understanding limits performance. Bounds: claims cover spatial alignment in robot VLA settings only, not general language reasoning or non-VLA perception stacks.
where.zh: 适用于在多样机器人数据上训练、受空间理解能力制约的 VLA 机器人策略。Bounds：仅限机器人 VLA 的空间对齐收益，不代表通用语言能力或非 VLA 感知架构的提升。

stories.titleZh: SLA：通过持续预训练扩展空间语言动作模型
stories.summaryZh: SLA 是一种空间语言动作模型，它不断地对预训练的 VLA 策略进行预训练和后训练，并与冻结的 3D 感知模型进行空间对齐，使用特征相关门和概率状态丢失来提高对不同机器人数据的空间理解，同时保留推理架构。

stories.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
stories.summary: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. Designed for single-GPU deployment in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications, the model processes text, reference images, and target latents as one interleaved sequence. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone combines shared attention with independent understanding and generation parameters to limit optimization interference. Equipping each path with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules provides sparse capacity, with 31.7B stored parameters and approximately 5.4B generation parameters activated per target latent token. A generation-oriented data engine combines a knowledge-grounded visual vocabulary with large-scale visual clustering to balance semantic coverage and editing tasks, while training-time evaluation guides iterative data refinement. Bilingual annotations and verified editing supervision support progressive training up to native 1.5K resolution. We optimize generation and editing separately with rubric- and checklist-based rewards, then consolidate the specialized policies through noise-aware on-policy distillation. In the reported overall comparisons, the 1536-resolution model ranks first among the evaluated open-source models on PRISM-Bench, Qwen-Image-Bench, and UnicBench. MeanFlow-based few-step distillation yields WeLM-Image-Turbo, which generates a 1024times1024 image in 4.98\,s on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU using eight guidance-free steps.

why.en: It shows understanding and generation can live in one model without destructive interference: MoT separates parameters, MoE sparsifies capacity, and separate rubric/checklist-rewarded policies are merged via noise-aware on-policy distillation — a reusable recipe for consolidating conflicting RL-trained policies.
why.zh: 它证明理解与生成可共存于单一模型:MoT 隔离参数避免优化干扰,MoE 提供稀疏容量,再用 rubric/checklist 奖励分别训练生成与编辑策略,并经 noise-aware on-policy 蒸馏合并——为冲突策略的整合提供了可复用配方。

where.en: Applies to single-GPU serving of text-to-image generation, instruction editing, and multi-reference synthesis in consumer products, and to post-training pipelines merging separately optimised policies. Bounds: rankings cover the three named benchmarks among evaluated open-source image models only — not video, video generation, or closed-model comparisons.
where.zh: 适用于消费级产品中单卡部署的文生图、指令编辑与多参考合成,以及需要合并分别优化策略的后训练流程。Bounds:排名结论仅限图像模型在所列三项 benchmark 上的开源对比,不外推到视频生成或闭源模型。

stories.titleZh: WeLM-Image：面向视觉智能的统一图像生成模型
stories.summaryZh: 我们提出了 WeLM-Image，这是一种统一的图像基础模型，它将多模态理解集成到文本到图像生成、指令引导编辑和多参考合成中。该模型专为微信大规模消费应用程序中的单 GPU 部署而设计，将文本、参考图像和目标潜在信息作为一个交错序列进行处理。混合变压器 (MoT) 主干将共享注意力与独立理解和生成参数结合起来，以限制优化干扰。为每条路径配备专家混合 (MoE) 模块可提供稀疏容量，每个目标潜在令牌激活 31.7B 存储参数和大约 5.4B 生成参数。面向生成的数据引擎将基于知识的视觉词汇与大规模视觉聚类相结合，以平衡语义覆盖和编辑任务，而训练时评估则指导迭代数据细化。双语注释和经过验证的编辑监督支持渐进式训练，最高可达原生 1.5K 分辨率。我们通过基于标题和清单的奖励分别优化生成和编辑，然后通过噪声感知的策略蒸馏来巩固专门的策略。在报告的总体比较中，1536分辨率模型在 PRISM-Bench、Qwen-Image-Bench 和 UnicBench 评估的开源模型中排名第一。基于 MeanFlow 的几步蒸馏产生了 WeLM-Image-Turbo，它使用八个无引导步骤在单个 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上在 4.98 秒内生成 1024×1024 图像。

stories.title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
stories.summary: EDGAR is a conditional diffusion framework with a fusion block and Mixture-of-Experts that refines degraded Gaussian head avatars by injecting self-supervised identity features, using refined multi-view renderings as pseudo-targets to optimize a single avatar.
stories.titleZh: EDGAR：通过合成失效进行高效的扩散驱动高斯化身细化
stories.summaryZh: EDGAR 是一个带有融合块和专家混合的条件扩散框架，通过注入自我监督的身份特征来细化退化的高斯头部头像，使用精致的多视图渲染作为伪目标来优化单个头像。

stories.summary: TB-MathModel is a terminal benchmark that makes complete contest-style mathematical modeling problems agentic and verifiable, scoring final numeric answers against multiple human references with feasibility checks.

stories.summaryZh: TB-MathModel 是一个终端基准测试，它使完整的竞赛式数学建模问题 agentic 变得可验证，并通过可行性检查根据多个人类参考对最终数字答案进行评分。

stories.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
stories.summary: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line. The post Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit appeared first on Microsoft Research .
stories.titleZh: 使用 PDD Kit 正式验证代理编写的全栈 Web 应用程序
stories.summaryZh: 人工智能代理可以生成人类难以逐行检查的规模的代码。 PDD 套件通过创建正式规范并对其进行测试，帮助确保代码按照开发人员的预期进行。它将开发人员的意图转换为 Verus 规范，证明人工智能生成的代码满足每个输入的要求，并在证明不切实际的情况下使用测试。开发人员会审查意图，而不是每一行。使用 PDD Kit 正式验证代理编写的全栈 Web 应用程序一文首先出现在 Microsoft Research 上。

stories.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
stories.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
stories.titleZh: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现和优化的潜在代理群
stories.summaryZh: LLM 引导的进化搜索使用 AI 代理，通过迭代改进解决方案并结合高分方法来改进数学和计算问题的程序。然而，这个过程通常很慢，因为法学硕士每轮都会生成很长的文本思想链，并且必须多次重复这一生成以保持群体多样性。我们提出了 SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮数百个低成本代理以群体的形式工作，在潜在空间中进行推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递 KV 缓存来共享信息。每个群体从不同的角度研究问题。新奇过滤器通过直接测量代理隐藏状态向量之间的距离来保留最独特的代理想法。思想的交叉在潜在空间中自然发生，因为摘要器代理接收所有群体成员的组合 KV 缓存。在数学发现和科学计算的 21 个问题上，SwarmEvolve 获得了最高的平均分数，并且只需要 3 到 8 分钟的中位数即可达到其他最先进框架在 60 分钟内达到的最佳分数。在几个问题上，SwarmEvolve 与 Qwen3 8B 改进了 AlphaEvolve 首次通过前沿 LLM 找到的解决方案。我们的工作表明，在潜在空间中进行通信的代理群为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。

stories.title: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
stories.summary: A token pruning and merging mechanism and a waveform-preserving augmentation improve a full-waveform LiDAR Transformer to real-time speed and higher accuracy with better generalization.
stories.titleZh: 通过强度引导令牌减少和物理感知增强实现实时全波形 LiDAR 变压器
stories.summaryZh: 令牌修剪和合并机制以及波形保留增强将全波形 LiDAR Transformer 提高到实时速度、更高的精度和更好的泛化能力。

stories.title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
stories.summary: NPCBench evaluates whether medical AI models can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and maintain temporally coherent diagnostic and care decisions across longitudinal nasopharyngeal carcinoma patient pathways.
stories.titleZh: NPCBench：鼻咽癌多模式护理路径推理的临床学徒基准
stories.summaryZh: NPCBench 评估医学 AI 模型是否可以将亚专业知识与多模式证据相结合，并在纵向鼻咽癌患者路径中保持时间上一致的诊断和护理决策。

stories.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
stories.summary: TailSteer, a final-stage training framework, reduces cumulative visual drift in multi-turn editing by keeping early denoising dynamics close to the base model and learning tail-focused preservation corrections from on-policy rollouts, preserving pretrained generative and editing abilities.
stories.titleZh: TailSteer：用于抗漂移多圈图像编辑的轨迹尾部转向
stories.summaryZh: TailSteer 是最后阶段的训练框架，通过保持早期去噪动态接近基本模型并从策略 rollouts 学习以尾部为中心的保留校正，从而保留预训练的生成和编辑能力，从而减少多轮编辑中的累积视觉漂移。

stories.title: Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
stories.summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanScale, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanScale-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.
stories.titleZh: Open-HumanScale：用于扩展实体基础模型的人类和机器人体验的开放方法
stories.summaryZh: 以自我为中心的人类视频为机器人学习提供了可扩展的操作先验来源，但将原始数据规模转化为可推广的机器人策略需要严格的数据管理和训练方法。我们推出了 Open-HumanScale，这是第一个将自我中心预训练扩展到 50,000 小时的完全开放方案，以 Open-HumanScale-50K 为基础——一个精心策划的以自我为中心的视频语料库，带有大量的手部动作和自然语言注释。利用该语料库，我们通过闭环模拟评估系统地研究纯人类预训练，并揭示了将预训练数据时间与下游机器人成功率联系起来的经验对数线性缩放定律。基于这些发现，我们开发了 HumanWAM-Vanilla，这是一个专门根据 5 万小时以自我为中心的人类视频进行预训练的世界动作模型。在机器人后期训练中，HumanWAM-Vanilla 在 RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean 上达到 92.08% 的成功率，在 Clean2Random 上达到 68.88% 的成功率，在 RoboDojo 上平均成功率为 14.17%，平均进度分数为 19.00。为了进一步推动能力前沿，我们探索使用 HumanWAM-Goal（一种视觉目标调节的世界动作模型）进行人机联合预训练。混合数据扩展在模拟和物理基准测试中解锁了广泛的零样本泛化，将训练后的 RoboTwin 2.0 性能提升到新的最先进水平：Clean2Clean 上的 92.70%，Clean2Random 上的显着跃升至 84.60%。在物理机器人上，HumanWAM-Goal 进一步展示了新兴的具体情境学习，无需参数更新即可动态调整其操纵行为以适应看不见的视觉目标。为了支持嵌入式 AI 中的可重复扩展研究，我们开源了 Open-HumanScale-50K 语料库、数据管理和预训练管道，以及预训练和后训练的 HumanWAM 检查点、推理代码和模拟评估套件。

stories.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
stories.summary: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
stories.titleZh: 论Prefill到自回归跨模型迁移的机遇和挑战
stories.summaryZh: Prefill 到自回归跨模型迁移 (PACT) 是语言模型之间潜在通信的一种形式，它将较大模型的即时表示与较小模型的高效生成相结合，提供了一种平衡能力和推理成本的有前途的方法。然而，现有系统对独立评估大小模型协作的支持有限，并且仅改进任务性能并不能确定接收者是否从发送者的信息中受益。我们引入了 PLAtour，这是一个开源 PACT 框架，它通过轻量级、零初始化的线性桥连接冻结模型，直接使用任务奖励进行训练，并支持混合注意力架构。 PLAtour 在生成任务上显着优于开源基线，并在使用小得多的发送器的共享数学和编码基准上超过了 Mostik 报告的结果。然而，对照实验表明，某些任务的收益可以通过无信息的发送者信号、自我通信或仅接收者训练来重现。我们发现可训练的桥可以充当参数有效的适应机制，而无需利用有用的发送者信息。因此，我们建议使用 PACT-Check 来量化经过训练的 PACT 系统的收益有多少真正来自于通信。最后，我们讨论了 PACT 系统的机遇和挑战。代码可在 https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour 获取。

stories.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
stories.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios.
In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola.
stories.titleZh: 工具不需要用文本说话：代理的潜在上下文压缩
stories.summaryZh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理通常将原始工具输出附加到其上下文中。在多步交互中，长时间且嘈杂的观察会产生大量的上下文开销，并削弱代理对任务相关信息的注意力。现有的标记修剪和摘要方法仍然受到离散文本表示的限制，限制了可实现的压缩比。
在这项工作中，我们挑战了普遍的假设，即代理必须将工具观察结果作为显式文本标记来使用。为此，我们提出了 Coca-Cola，一种用于 LLM 代理的连续潜在上下文压缩模型。可口可乐将工具观察结果压缩为潜在标记，并将它们嵌入到代理的输入嵌入空间中。我们进一步引入了动作保留训练，它在完整和压缩的观察下调整代理的下一步动作分布。这训练压缩模型来学习保留决策关键信息的足够动作的潜在令牌。在四个 QA 基准和两个模型系列上对网络搜索代理进行的实验表明，可口可乐将代理的令牌消耗减少了 70.01%-89.24%，将端到端运行时间减少了 24.45%-55.97%，同时持续提高了任务性能。这些结果表明，可口可乐为代理中的上下文压缩提供了一种有前途的方法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola 获取。

stories.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
stories.summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts with two complementary states: Relational States that capture how facts remain valid and relate to one another as memory evolves, and a Reasoning State that determines how these facts should be applied to the current request. Specifically, EvoMemState consists of three key components: (i) Ontology-Guided Memory State Induction extracts Persistent Facts and constructs Relational States that maintain their validity, scope, and evolving relations. (ii) RL-Based State Evolution internalizes memory-use experience into a policy through reinforcement learning to generate a request-specific Reasoning State. (iii) State-Aware Reasoning then combines the relevant facts with their Relational States and the generated Reasoning State to guide the personal agent. Extensive experiments on long-term dialogue and memory-use benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing memory systems in retrieval completeness and memory-grounded response accuracy. Our code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/EvoMemState.git.
stories.titleZh: EvoMemState：个人代理的进化内存状态
stories.summaryZh: 长期记忆使大语言模型 (LLM) 代理能够通过在交互过程中保留用户信息来提供持续的个性化帮助。现有系统通过事实提取、组织、更新和检索来支持这一过程，但很大程度上将记忆保留为独立的事实。这种以事实为中心的范式可能会忽略新事实如何更新、约束或与早期事实发生冲突，同时隐含地保留它们对当前请求的适用性、作用和优先级。在本文中，我们介绍了 EvoMemState，这是一种以状态为中心的框架，它通过两个互补状态来增强持久性事实：关系状态​​捕获事实如何保持有效并随着内存的发展而相互关联，推理状态确定如何将这些事实应用于当前请求。具体来说，EvoMemState 由三个关键组件组成：（i）本体引导的记忆状态归纳提取持久事实并构建维持其有效性、范围和不断发展的关系的关系状态。 (ii) 基于强化学习的状态进化通过强化学习将内存使用经验内化到策略中，以生成特定于请求的推理状态。 (iii) 状态感知推理然后将相关事实与其关系状态以及生成的推理状态相结合以指导个人代理。对长期对话和记忆使用基准的大量实验表明，在检索完整性和基于记忆的响应准确性方面，现有记忆系统取得了持续改进。我们的代码和实现细节可在 https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/EvoMemState.git 获取。

stories.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
stories.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can achieve surprisingly strong performance with high probability, but remains unstable due to rare large errors. We further show that this instability is inherent to modern foundation models and persists even as more models are evaluated. Based on these findings, we introduce BestRand, a stable and low-cost benchmark compression method that preserves the efficiency of random sampling while substantially reducing its high-error tail. We validate BestRand on 70+ text, multimodal, and agent benchmarks, and further extend it to VLA evaluation. Compared with competitive methods, BestRand reduces high-error risk by 50.2% and estimation error by 16.4% on average, while requiring only 51.3% of the construction cost. It further reduces OOD estimation error by 21.8% on average across score-range, model-family, and temporal shifts. Together, our theory provides practical guidance for understanding and predicting the accuracy and reliability of benchmark compression, while BestRand enables stable and accurate compression at low cost. The code and data are publicly available onhttps://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand.
stories.titleZh: 随机就足够了吗？通过 BestRand 实现稳定且低成本的基准压缩
stories.summaryZh: 基准压缩通过在与全基准结果紧密匹配的小型基准子集上评估模型，减少了模型评估通常令人望而却步的时间和成本。为了量化估计误差，我们在估计子集的全基准分数时得出了误差分布的准确分析近似值，表明大多数子集产生较小的误差，而少数子集产生更大的误差，从而形成长尾分布。这意味着仅随机采样就可以以高概率实现令人惊讶的强大性能，但由于罕见的大错误而保持不稳定。我们进一步表明，这种不稳定性是现代基础模型所固有的，并且即使评估更多模型也仍然存在。基于这些发现，我们引入了 BestRand，这是一种稳定且低成本的基准压缩方法，可以保留随机采样的效率，同时大幅减少其高误差尾部。我们在 70 多个文本、多模式和代理基准上验证 BestRand，并将其进一步扩展到 VLA 评估。与竞争方法相比，BestRand 平均降低了 50.2% 的高错误风险和 16.4% 的估算误差，而仅需要 51.3% 的建设成本。它进一步将分数范围、模型系列和时间变化的 OOD 估计误差平均降低了 21.8%。总之，我们的理论为理解和预测基准压缩的准确性和可靠性提供了实用指导，而 BestRand 能够以低成本实现稳定和准确的压缩。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand 上公开获取。

stories.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
stories.summary: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.
stories.titleZh: WeVisOne-VL：从物体到像素的统一视觉感知
stories.summaryZh: WeVisOne-VL 通过结构化标记预测统一了对象级和像素级视觉感知，通过轻量级像素解码器和多阶段训练支持检测、定位、计数、OCR、分割和抠图。

why.en: Unifying object- and pixel-level perception in one structured-token model, with only a lightweight pixel decoder, means VLM stacks can drop separate task-specific vision heads — six perception capabilities under a single interface and multi-stage training recipe.
why.zh: 用 structured token prediction 将 object 级与 pixel 级感知统一进单个模型，pixel decoder 保持轻量，意味着视觉栈可裁掉多个专用 head，六种感知能力共用同一接口与多阶段训练流程。

where.en: Fits as the visual front-end for VLMs and multimodal agents needing detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation or matting. Bounds: perception only — no evidence here on language reasoning, RL training, or agentic decision-making.
where.zh: 适用于 VLM 与多模态 agent 的视觉前端，覆盖 detection、localization、counting、OCR、segmentation、matting。Bounds: 仅限感知能力，不涉及语言推理、RL 训练或 agent 决策。

stories.summary: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning enables video diffusion transformers to leverage multimodal language model representations for sparse temporal inference and factor-aware cinematic control through staged grounding and optimization.
stories.titleZh: 让 MLLM 潜伏变得重要：用于电影视频生成的因子感知预测学习
stories.summaryZh: 因子感知预测学习使视频扩散转换器能够利用多模态语言模型表示，通过分阶段的基础和优化来进行稀疏时间推理和因子感知电影控制。

why.en: It converts MLLM latents into an actionable conditioning interface for video diffusion transformers, pairing an efficiency lever (sparse temporal inference) with factor-level cinematic control instead of prompt-only steering.
why.zh: 该工作把 MLLM 的 latent 变成 video diffusion transformer 可直接调用的条件接口：既带来稀疏时间推理的效率收益，又提供 factor 级影视控制，而非仅靠 prompt 引导生成。

where.en: Relevant to cinematic video generation stacks built on video diffusion transformers with MLLM representations. Bounds: not evidence about MLLM reasoning quality, image-only generation, or text-to-video without such conditioning.
where.zh: 适用于以 MLLM 表征为条件、基于 video diffusion transformer 的影视级视频生成流程。Bounds: 不能外推到 MLLM 推理能力本身、纯图像生成或无此类条件的通用视频合成。

stories.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
stories.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.
stories.titleZh: IQuest-Q1：提升 Agentic CLI 系统的基础功能
stories.summaryZh: 我们提出了 IQuest-Q1，这是一个稀疏专家混合 (MoE) agentic 基础模型，具有 320B 总参数（15B 激活）。 IQuest-Q1通过三阶段过程开发：（1）稳定高效的预训练，将Stable SplitNorm、Muon和muP与两阶段课程相结合，第二阶段增加编码数据混合，在安全和最佳学习率之间保持较宽的稳定性裕度； （2）细粒度的中期训练，扩展跨领域和跨格式的数据混合，并逐步扩展上下文； (3) 具有多版本后训练的多支架，将 SFT、领域专用 RL 和跨各种支架的 MOPD 相结合，以整合互补的训练信号并增强 agentic 编码能力。此外，模型合并结合了不同阶段的不同专家和检查点，同时减轻了参数更新之间的冲突。由此产生的 IQuest-Q1 展示了编码和一般任务的功能。我们将 IQuest-Q1 作为开源模型发布，以支持社区研究和开发。

why.en: An open-weights 320B/15B MoE built for agentic coding gives the community a reusable foundation model, and the multi-scaffold post-training plus cross-stage model merging offers a concrete recipe for combining complementary SFT/RL signals while avoiding parameter conflicts.
why.zh: 开源 320B 总参/15B 激活的 MoE 为社区提供了可复用的 agentic coding 基座；其 multi-scaffold post-training 与跨阶段 model merging 给出了一套整合互补 SFT/RL 信号并缓解参数冲突的可操作配方。

where.en: Applies to teams building or fine-tuning MoE foundation models for CLI coding agents and tool-use workflows. Bounds: do not extrapolate to dense models, non-coding agents, or capabilities beyond the reported scaffolds and coding/general evaluations.
where.zh: 适用于构建或微调 MoE 基座模型以支撑 CLI 编码智能体与工具调用场景的团队。Bounds：不宜外推到 dense 模型、非编码智能体，或超出论文所述 scaffolds 与 coding/general 评测范围的能力结论。

stories.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
stories.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark and evaluation framework for video-centered deep research agents that synthesize external evidence into interactive reports linked to video moments.
stories.titleZh: 超越观看和搜索：以视频为中心的深度研究报告的基准测试代理
stories.summaryZh: 研究人员为以视频为中心的深度研究代理引入了基准和评估框架，将外部证据合成为与视频时刻相关的交互式报告。

stories.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
stories.summary: Raw retrieval-augmented generation over unprocessed conversation history outperforms complex agentic memory systems across multiple benchmarks, indicating that preserving raw evidence is more critical than elaborate memory transformations.
stories.titleZh: 是否总是需要复杂的 Agentic 内存？天真的 RAG 比我们想象的更强大
stories.summaryZh: 未经处理的对话历史记录的原始检索增强生成在多个基准测试中优于复杂的 agentic 记忆系统，这表明保留原始证据比精心设计的记忆转换更重要。

stories.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
stories.summary: Verus-Insight improves AI-generated video detection by training artifact detectors through structured inspection planning, evidence verification, and evidence aggregation with human-anchored supervision.

stories.summaryZh: Verus-Insight 通过结构化检查规划、证据验证和人工监督下的证据聚合来训练伪影检测器，从而改进人工智能生成的视频检测。

stories.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
stories.summary: AgentVQA is an offline benchmark assessing vision-language models on realistic agentic tasks across web, robotics, video, games, and spatial planning, revealing that visual grounding and state tracking errors are the primary failure modes.
stories.titleZh: AgentVQA：Agentic 视觉理解的统一基准
stories.summaryZh: AgentVQA 是一个离线基准测试，评估跨网络、机器人、视频、游戏和空间规划的真实 agentic 任务的视觉语言模型，揭示视觉基础和状态跟踪错误是主要的故障模式。

stories.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
stories.summary: AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative model that transforms low-quality agent-built game footage into high-fidelity visuals while preserving layout, camera, and entity timing.
stories.titleZh: AnyGameRenderer：跨游戏的实体一致生成渲染和实体级基准
stories.summaryZh: AnyGameRenderer 是一种视频到视频生成模型，可将代理构建的低质量游戏镜头转换为高保真视觉效果，同时保留布局、相机和实体计时。

stories.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models

stories.titleZh: 继承，而非发明：在推理模型中追踪等待的起源
stories.summaryZh: 强化学习无需特定的等待标记即可提高推理准确性，该等待标记源自训练数据而不是强化学习，并且自动评估指标可能会歪曲推理趋势。

stories.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.
stories.titleZh: 通过视频阅读、写作、分享、与世界互动
stories.summaryZh: 这项调查通过世界建模统一了视频理解和生成，组织了围绕推断、合成、共享以及与潜在时间状态交互的进展，以强调剪辑级别感知的持久动态。

stories.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
stories.summary: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.
stories.titleZh: RIDAR：通过自动检测和运行时干预保护自主研究代理的研究完整性
stories.summaryZh: RIDAR 通过基于分类的事后分析和实时干预来检测并减轻自主代理中的研究完整性违规行为。

stories.summary: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.

stories.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
stories.summary: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.
stories.titleZh: 机器人世界模型的基于骨骼的潜在动作模型
stories.summaryZh: SkeLAM 将潜在动作分解为骨架引导的运动学和残余分量，以改进可控机器人世界建模和运动传递。

stories.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
stories.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.
stories.titleZh: 物理人工智能的递归自我完善
stories.summaryZh: 递归自我改进 (RSI) 描述的系统不仅可以改进其行为，还可以改进其改进的过程。最近的数字代理通过重写自己的代码并使用可执行测试检查每个版本来测试这个想法。将这些机制带入物理世界需要通过昂贵的试验从部分观察中学习，同时考虑到不断变化的操作条件和潜在的不可逆转的后果。我们将 RSI 置于机器人学习中，并追踪从提高机器人能力到改进生成机器人能力的流程的路径。我们研究身体体验如何加强这些改进机制，以及由此产生的收益何时可以支持机制本身的进一步自我改进。只有当反馈解决了剩余的学习需求、接收组件可以使用更改、其价值在任务或硬件的变化中仍然存在、并且持续的实践仍然是安全且负担得起的时，收益才会得以延续。现有的研究集中在操作上，支持行为改善、对以后学习的好处以及程序改进。有些系统还改变了改进者的知识或工具，但这里回顾的物理研究尚未分离出可归因于递归的收益。我们将这些发现综合成机器的评估原则和研究方向，通过反复试验，安全地改进它们的改进方式。

stories.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
stories.summary: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.
stories.titleZh: LaLa-World：用自然语言动作扩展潜在世界模型
stories.summaryZh: LaLa-World 是一种语言条件的潜在世界模型，它共同从不同的模拟、机器人和视频数据中学习，以实现高效的模型预测规划和策略初始化。

stories.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
stories.summary: FRED improves single-step future video representations in world action models through self-distillation and temporal conditioning, boosting robot policy performance on long-horizon and unseen tasks.
stories.titleZh: 世界行动模型的自我蒸馏未来视频表示

stories.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
stories.summary: LLM agents frequently leak sensitive conclusions assembled from multiple confidential documents, and common safeguards fail to eliminate this mosaic-style disclosure risk.

stories.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
stories.summary: In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. Sage-A1.5 highlights three improvements: agentic orchestration, verification, and open scientific discovery. First, agentic orchestration extends single-agent execution through task delegation and parallel collaboration among subagents with isolated contexts, enabling complex tasks to be decomposed and addressed concurrently and supporting efficient execution while reducing interference across concurrent subagents. Second, agentic verification strengthens long-horizon reliability through progress checking, evidence validation, and reflective strategy revision, allowing the agent to recognize unproductive search paths and pursue alternative approaches. Third, open scientific discovery extends agentic capabilities beyond answering predefined questions to conducting exploratory research, connecting scientific inquiry with interactive analysis and inspectable research artifacts. We showcase these capabilities through complicated agentic tasks and multidisciplinary scientific applications. Besides, we hope Sage-A1.5 provides the community with an accessible foundation for open scientific discovery, offering a practical path from long-horizon task execution to collaborative, verifiable, and inspectable scientific exploration.
stories.titleZh: Sage-A1.5：从远景执行到能力构成的科学探索
stories.summaryZh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Sage-A1.5，这是一个 35B 专家混合 agentic 模型，它基于 A1 构建，通过自适应能力组合推进长期问题解决。与 A1 相比，Sage-A1.5 不仅学习解决单个任务，还学习组织工作并在执行过程中修改其方法。 Sage-A1.5 突出了三项改进：agentic 编排、验证和开放科学发现。首先，agentic 编排通过任务委托和具有隔离上下文的子代理之间的并行协作来扩展单代理执行，从而能够同时分解和处理复杂的任务，并支持高效执行，同时减少并发子代理之间的干扰。其次，agentic 验证通过进度检查、证据验证和反思策略修订来增强长期可靠性，使代理能够识别无效的搜索路径并寻求替代方法。第三，开放式科学发现将 agentic 的能力扩展到回答预定义问题之外，还可以进行探索性研究，将科学探究与交互式分析和可检查的研究工件联系起来。我们通过复杂的 agentic 任务和多学科科学应用来展示这些功能。此外，我们希望Sage-A1.5为社区提供开放科学发现的基础，提供从长期任务执行到协作、可验证和可检查的科学探索的实用路径。

why.en: Sage-A1.5 signals a shift from task-solving agents to capability-composing ones: parallel subagents with isolated contexts plus mid-execution verification target the named failure modes of long-horizon work — interference and unproductive search — and push agents toward inspectable open scientific discovery.
why.zh: Sage-A1.5 从解单点任务转向能力组合：上下文隔离的 subagent 并行协作加执行中自我验证，直接针对 long-horizon 工作中的干扰与无效搜索问题，并把 agent 从回答预设问题推向可检验的开放式科学发现。

where.en: Applies to long-horizon agent systems needing task decomposition, parallel subagents, and reflective verification, and to agent-driven scientific exploration workflows. Bounds: claims rest on this 35B MoE report's showcased tasks; do not generalize to production reliability, other model scales, or independently verified discovery.
where.zh: 适用于需要任务分解、subagent 并行与反思式验证的 long-horizon agent 系统，以及 agent 驱动的科学探索工作流。Bounds：结论仅基于该 35B MoE 报告展示的任务，不应外推到生产可靠性、其他规模模型或经独立验证的科学发现。

stories.title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
stories.summary: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. As information is shared, corrected, and revised across documents, chats, and figures, multiple versions of the same information accumulate in the workspace. Reliable question answering therefore requires agents to reason over sufficient evidence, resolve cross-source and temporal conflicts, and recognize when the available evidence is insufficient to establish an answer. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce MMEnterprise-Bench, a benchmark comprising 1,613 questions grounded in evolving multimodal records from simulated collaboration projects, covering three categories: Evidence Reasoning, Conflict Resolution, and Unanswerability. We evaluate 10 proprietary and open-source multimodal LLMs and find that even the strongest models struggle when evidence contains cross-source or temporal conflicts or spans multiple images. Moreover, increasing the retrieval budget or employing a larger retriever improves evidence recall but does not consistently translate into higher answer accuracy. These findings highlight the persistent challenges of reasoning over evolving workplace records and establish MMEnterprise-Bench as a testbed for developing more reliable enterprise agents. Code and data are available at https://mlvlab.github.io/MMEnterprise-Bench/.
stories.titleZh: MMEnterprise-Bench：根据不断变化的多模式记录评估企业代理
stories.summaryZh: 企业代理回答有关通过团队协作演变的工作场所记录的问题。随着信息在文档、聊天和图表中共享、更正和修订，同一信息的多个版本会在工作区中积累。因此，可靠的问答要求智能体对足够的证据进行推理，解决跨源和时间冲突，并识别可用证据何时不足以建立答案。为了系统地评估这些能力，我们引入了 MMEnterprise-Bench，这是一个包含 1,613 个问题的基准，这些问题基于模拟协作项目中不断演变的多模式记录，涵盖三个类别：证据推理、冲突解决和不可回答性。我们评估了 10 个专有和开源多模式法学硕士，发现当证据包含跨源或时间冲突或跨越多个图像时，即使是最强大的模型也会陷入困境。此外，增加检索预算或使用更大的检索器可以提高证据召回率，但并不能始终转化为更高的答案准确性。这些发现凸显了对不断变化的工作场所记录进行推理所面临的持续挑战，并将 MMEnterprise-Bench 建立为开发更可靠的企业代理的测试平台。代码和数据可在 https://mlvlab.github.io/MMEnterprise-Bench/ 获取。

stories.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
stories.summary: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code.
stories.titleZh: S-Agent 2.0：使用通用编码代理进行空间推理
stories.summaryZh: 空间推理要求模型计算出物体在 3D 空间中的位置、它们之间的关系以及它们的移动方式。 Agentic VLM 最近对此类任务进行了重大改进，让模型使用 3D 感知工具主动收集证据，而不是一次性回答。即便如此，在许多问题上，工具返回了正确的证据，而模型仍然没有得出正确的答案：模型和工具之间的差距（原始读数成为可用的结论）尚未填补。我们推出了 S-Agent 2.0，这是一种空间推理代理，为现成的通用编码代理配备了命令行感知工具包，我们围绕一个原则设计了界面：帮助 VLM 闭合证据循环：获取场景证据，将其记住在持久的场景记忆中，并用简单的空间语言解释每个读数。这种设计保持了编码代理的全部灵活性，并且它所作用的每个读数都以工具的几何形状为基础。在 MMSI-Bench 和 ReVSI 上，该工具包将强大的开源模型 Qwen3.8-27B 与没有工具的相同代理相比提高了 +13.9 和 +20.5 点，并将强大的闭源模型 Gemini-3.8-Flash 提高了 +11.2 和 +9.6 点。开放主干网 S-Agent 2.0 在 MMSI-Bench 上达到 66.5，在 ReVSI 上达到 82.3，领先于同一主干网上的专用系统 SpatialClaw（62.6 和 74.5），而在 Gemini-3.8-Flash 上，它达到 74.1 和 90.5，而其分别为 67.0 和 79.7。随着主干网能力的增强，这两种工具的增益都会缩小，但 SpatialClaw 在 ReVSI 上的缩小幅度要大得多，从 +13.2 降至 +2.7，而我们的则保持在 +9.6。 S-Agent 2.0 还适用于不同的通用编码代理工具，例如 Codex 和 Claude Code。

stories.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
stories.summary: Matrix-Game 4.0 separates game logic from visual synthesis via an executable engine and autoregressive video renderer, achieving real-time interactive gameplay with low latency.
stories.titleZh: Matrix-Game 4.0：利用视频模型实现实时可玩的游戏世界
stories.summaryZh: Matrix-Game 4.0通过可执行引擎和自回归视频渲染器将游戏逻辑与视觉合成分离，以低latency实现实时互动游戏。

stories.title: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
stories.summary: EvaOmni is an evidence-grounded benchmark that evaluates whether omnimodal language models identify audio-visual evidence and construct reasoning chains for audiovisual questions.
stories.titleZh: EvaOmni：视听推理的循证基准
stories.summaryZh: EvaOmni 是一个基于证据的基准，用于评估全模态语言模型是否识别视听证据并构建视听问题的推理链。

stories.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
stories.summary: Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. Stochastic errors can propagate through actions and context, creating a gap between capability and reliable execution. We present RiseHarness, a framework for iteratively improving agent harnesses with model weights fixed. It focuses on flipping tasks with both successful and failed runs under the same configuration, using successful runs as references for failure analysis. RiseHarness combines agent trajectories with internal harness traces from a runtime monitor to examine how model actions interact with command execution, feedback, context management, and completion decisions. A Harness Handbook links this evidence to harness behaviors and source code, helping identify recurring problems in mechanisms shared across tasks. RiseHarness then searches other harness frameworks for relevant implementations and adapts them as design references to the current model and execution protocol. Candidate changes undergo behavioral checks and repeated task evaluation; versions with measured gains seed the next iteration. This loop integrates suitable mechanisms from different frameworks into a single harness and uses new execution evidence to guide further changes. We evaluate task success and reliability across models, ablate harness execution evidence and external research, and test transfer to unseen benchmarks with the same model. RiseHarness treats a specific model as the unit of harness adaptation, studying how changes to shared interaction mechanisms can make existing capabilities more reliable across tasks.
stories.titleZh: Harness 长视野终端代理的自我进化
stories.summaryZh: 长视野终端代理可能会在一次运行中解决一项任务，但在重复运行时会失败。随机错误可以通过操作和上下文传播，从而在能力和可靠执行之间造成差距。我们提出了 RiseHarness，一个用于迭代改进模型权重固定的代理线束的框架。它侧重于翻转相同配置下运行成功和失败的任务，以成功运行作为失败分析的参考。 RiseHarness 将代理轨迹与运行时监视器的内部 harness 跟踪相结合，以检查模型操作如何与命令执行、反馈、上下文管理和完成决策交互。 harness 手册将这些证据与 harness 行为和源代码联系起来，帮助识别跨任务共享机制中反复出现的问题。然后，RiseHarness 搜索其他 harness 框架的相关实现，并将它们调整为当前模型和执行协议的设计参考。候选人变更要经过行为检查和重复任务评估；具有测量增益的版本为下一次迭代提供种子。该循环将不同框架中的合适机制集成到单个 harness 中，并使用新的执行证据来指导进一步的更改。我们跨模型评估任务的成功和可靠性，消除 harness 执行证据和外部研究，并使用同一模型测试转移到未见过的基准。 RiseHarness 将特定模型视为 harness 适配的单元，研究共享交互机制的改变如何使现有功能在跨任务时更加可靠。

stories.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
stories.summary: Policy-Mask learns a budget-conditioned selection policy over diffusion timesteps, network blocks, and channels to extract compact, task-optimal features for discriminative vision tasks.
stories.titleZh: 策略掩模：扩散特征对歧视性任务的预算感知适应
stories.summaryZh: Policy-Mask 在扩散时间步长、网络块和通道上学习预算条件选择策略，为判别性视觉任务提取紧凑的、任务最优的特征。

stories.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
stories.summary: Code2Video-Compass is a benchmark evaluating multimodal language models on code-based video generation across text, image, and video inputs, revealing significant challenges in complex dynamic and state-dependent tasks.
stories.titleZh: Code2Video-Compass：跨 T2V、I2V 和 V2V 的通用基于代码的视频生成的综合基准
stories.summaryZh: Code2Video-Compass 是一个基准测试，评估跨文本、图像和视频输入的基于代码的视频生成的多模态语言模型，揭示了复杂动态和状态相关任务中的重大挑战。

stories.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
stories.summary: RLSplat enables feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting with linear reductions in latency, memory, and model size by allocating Gaussians regionally and decoding them via local attention.
stories.titleZh: RLSplat：前馈 3D 高斯分布的资源线性预算控制
stories.summaryZh: RLSplat 通过区域分配高斯并通过局部注意力对其进行解码，实现前馈 3D 高斯分布，并线性减少 latency、内存和模型大小。

stories.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
stories.summary: Diffusion language models spend more computation on novel, rare, or incorrect outputs, and decoding speed can improve inference efficiency and reliability.
stories.titleZh: 扩散语言模型改变任务和语言的速度
stories.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型在新颖、罕见或不正确的输出上花费更多计算，解码速度可以提高推理效率和可靠性。

stories.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
stories.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
stories.titleZh: OpenVLHarness：真实世界视觉 Agentic 工具与多模态内存的使用
stories.summaryZh: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在视觉推理方面取得了快速进展，但许多任务需要仅通过内部推理很难获得的证据：我们对 22 个基准的对照研究表明，简单地增加基础模型的推理预​​算只能产生适度的收益。此类任务需要通过异构工具获得扎根的感知、外部知识和数值测量，其输出必须可由模型解释并在推理步骤中保留。我们介绍 OpenVLHarness，这是一种围绕功能层和持久多模态内存组织的多模态推理 harness。能力层将任务级工具接口与证据渲染相结合，提供对异构后端的一致访问，并将其输出转换为模型可读的观察结果。持久多模式内存将相应的图像、结构化数据和网络引用保留为每个查询中的可寻址工件。编码接口在存储的数据上执行生成的程序，从而能够组合多个工具的结果进行计算。这些机制共同支持获取、检查和组合多模式证据的迭代过程。在具有 8 个开放和专有骨干网的 22 个基准测试上进行评估后，OpenVLHarness 的平均得分比匹配的无工具基准提高了 9.7-12.6 分，其中 Qwen3-VL-8B 为 +11.2，Kimi K3 为 +9.7，GPT-6 Astra 为 +9.9。使用中等推理 effort 的 GPT-6 Luna，OpenVLHarness 在最大 effort 上比基本模型、Codex 和 Visual Sketchpad 好 7.7-8.5 个点，同时最多花费其模型令牌成本的 37%。

stories.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
stories.summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
stories.titleZh: MemT-1.0：迈向内存原生进化
stories.summaryZh: 记忆本机进化要求使记忆成为基础模型的内在能力，使它们能够不断积累和利用信息。为此，我们引入了 MemT-1.0，这是一种新的内存基础模型架构，它将内存内部化为模型计算的一部分。 MemT-1.0 建立在 Metis 的基础上，采用门控 DeltaNet-2，在每轮内具有稳定的令牌级内存更新机制。我们进一步引入混合存储来扩展本机内存容量。经过深思熟虑的主干准备后，我们开发了一个两阶段的训练管道，包括持续的预训练和后训练，并由 34B 代币的训练数据和高效的训练和推理基础设施支持。我们发布了MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash的型号系列，并对内存和通用能力进行了全面评估。结果表明，它们平均优于参数化记忆基线，并且与检索增强方法保持竞争力，同时在很大程度上保留了一般功能。相对于完整上下文 KV cache，在 128K 代币的历史长度下，MemT-1.0-Nano 实现了约 1.86 美元\times$ 的端到端推理加速，并减少了 66\times$ 的持久存储。通过内化检索到的程序经验，MemT-1.0 提高了 agentic 任务的成功率，为内存原生进化迈出了切实可行的一步。

why.en: Internalizing memory into model compute — instead of external retrieval or an ever-growing KV cache — reframes long-history agents as an architecture problem; the reported 1.86x speedup and 66x storage cut at 128K context make persistent-context agents economically viable, and internalized procedural experience lifts agentic success.
why.zh: 将 memory 内化为模型计算本身,而非外挂检索或全量 KV cache,把长历史 agent 的成本问题转为架构问题;128K 下 1.86x 推理加速、66x 存储缩减,且内化过程性经验提升 agent 任务成功率,显示 memory-native 路线具备可行性。

where.en: Applies to agent stacks needing persistent long-horizon memory and efficient 128K-scale serving, and to pipelines that add memory via continued pre-training plus post-training on a prepared backbone. Bounds: evidence covers the released Nano/Flash family at tested history lengths; not proof that internal memory fully replaces retrieval or preserves all general capabilities.
where.zh: 适用于需要持久长程记忆与 128K 级高效推理的 agent 场景,以及在预训练 backbone 上经 continued pre-training 与 post-training 注入记忆的训练流程。Bounds: 结论仅基于 Nano/Flash 在已测历史长度下的表现,不能推广为内建记忆可全面取代 retrieval 或无损保留全部通用能力。

stories.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
stories.summary: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.
stories.titleZh: ScaleNav：用于语言条件本地导航的可扩展互联网视频预训练
stories.summaryZh: ScaleNav 从互联网以自我为中心的视频中学习目标导向的视觉动态，以生成用于语言条件本地导航的机器人动作，从而在模拟和现实世界部署中实现高成功率。

why.en: It shows internet egocentric video — abundant and free of action labels — can be distilled into goal-directed dynamics that directly produce robot actions, offering a scalable data path for language-conditioned navigation that survives the sim-to-real jump.
why.zh: 它证明海量且无需动作标注的互联网第一人称视频，可被蒸馏为目标导向的视觉动力学并直接输出机器人动作，为 language-conditioned 导航提供了可扩展的数据来源，且经受住了 sim-to-real 的检验。

where.en: Applies to robot local navigation tasks conditioned on language commands, with actions generated from video pretraining. Bounds: local navigation only — not manipulation, long-horizon planning, or settings lacking egocentric video priors.
where.zh: 适用于基于语言指令的机器人局部导航，动作由视频预训练生成。Bounds: 仅限 local navigation，不适用于机械臂操作、长程规划或缺乏第一人称视频先验的场景。

stories.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
stories.summary: Researchers introduce AnyGoal to evaluate whether world models can generalize dynamics to unseen combinations of familiar states and actions for planning.
stories.titleZh: AnyGoal：超越专家 Rollouts 的世界模型泛化
stories.summaryZh: 研究人员引入 AnyGoal 来评估世界模型是否可以将动态推广到熟悉状态和规划行动的未见组合。

stories.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
stories.summary: FocusGUI is a lightweight adapter that dynamically selects relevant multimodal evidence for GUI agents to prevent compounding errors from irrelevant context, improving action accuracy without fine-tuning the backbone.
stories.titleZh: 专注的全模式 GUI 代理
stories.summaryZh: FocusGUI 是一个轻量级适配器，可为 GUI 代理动态选择相关的多模式证据，以防止不相关上下文中出现复合错误，从而在没有 fine-tuning 主干的情况下提高操作准确性。

why.en: GUI agents that ingest omni-modal inputs compound errors when irrelevant evidence gets in; a lightweight adapter that filters evidence lifts action accuracy without backbone fine-tuning, making it a cheap add-on rather than a retrain.
why.zh: 全模态 GUI agent 易被无关证据干扰并导致误差累积；FocusGUI 以轻量 adapter 动态筛选多模态证据，在不微调 backbone 的情况下提升动作准确率，是即插即用的低成本改进。

where.en: Applies to multimodal GUI agents running on a fixed backbone with multiple evidence streams. Bounds: not shown for text-only agents, non-GUI multimodal tasks, or cases where backbone updates are actually required.
where.zh: 适用于基于固定 backbone、需融合多模态证据的 GUI agent。Bounds: 不适用于纯文本 agent 或非 GUI 场景，也未证明可替代 backbone 微调。

stories.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
stories.summary: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.
stories.titleZh: 长上下文线性注意力的克罗内克德尔塔规则
stories.summaryZh: 我们提出了 KronLSTM，一种基于 Kronecker Delta 规则的线性注意力架构，Kronecker Delta 规则是一种新颖的关联矩阵记忆更新规则。 KronLSTM 通过内存修改机制扩展了 xLSTM 系列，该机制可以纠正目标关联，同时仅沿矩阵空间中的单个方向修改内存。与增量规则更新相比，这种微创内存修订减少了对先前存储的信息的干扰，使其特别适合长上下文语言建模。由此产生的记忆动态可以在数学上描述为收敛到稳态分布的马尔可夫链，而记忆矩阵的预期范数在整个输入序列中保持均匀有界。因此，KronLSTM 确保稳定的内存动态，而不需要额外的内存状态标准化和稳定机制。实验表明，KronLSTM 与现有的线性注意力架构（包括（门控）DeltaNet 系列模型）具有竞争力，并且通常优于现有的线性注意力架构，在长上下文基准测试中具有特别强大的性能。这些结果将克罗内克德尔塔规则确立为循环线性注意力架构中稳定联想记忆的有效且易于分析的基础。我们的代码 (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) 和模型 (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) 是开源的。

stories.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
stories.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.
stories.titleZh: AdaExploreBench：对 LLM 代理进行基准测试，以在不断变化的环境中进行主动探索和测试时适应
stories.summaryZh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地部署在陌生且不断变化的环境中，要求它们主动探索、理解和适应环境动态。然而，现有的基准测试很少测试代理是否能够主动发现环境如何工作并随着环境的发展进行适应。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 AdaExploreBench，这是一个在不断变化的环境中进行主动探索和测试时间适应的基准。通过将环境动态实例化为隐藏规则，AdaExploreBench 要求智能体主动获取证据并推断规则。在隐式规则漂移下，潜在规则会在没有公告的情况下发生变化，要求代理从性能下降中检测到先验知识已过时并重新探索。对八个领先的法学硕士进行的实验表明，主动和自适应探索仍然具有挑战性：GPT-6 Sol 仅达到 61.9% 的校准精度，同时提供足够的证据或消除规则漂移，将平均性能显着提高了近 10%。这些结果揭示了当前法学硕士代理人的一个关键瓶颈：一旦获得信息证据，他们通常可以有效地进行推理，但很难主动获取正确的证据并识别先前获取的证据何时不再有效。

stories.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
stories.summary: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
stories.titleZh: HarnessPro：递归 Harness 通过 Pareto 优化进行自我改进以实现性能成本权衡
stories.summaryZh: harness 的开发在构建强大的 AI 代理方面发挥着至关重要的作用。最近的方法通过递归自我改进（RSI）来改进工具，但它们的性能提升通常伴随着更高的执行成本。我们推出了 HarnessPro，这是一种无标签方法，用于改进线束以提高任务性能，同时降低执行成本。在此设置中，候选线束使用 LLM 生成的测试进行评估，而无需访问地面实况解决方案或官方测试。专业代理诊断执行轨迹，根据不同的性能成本优先级计划更新，并将其作为候选工具实施。 HarnessPro 不是返回单个 harness，而是使用归一化加权平方距离选择，为不同的部署预算提供注重成本（轻型）、平衡（中型）和注重性能（重型）的线束。选定的线束进入下一次迭代，其中执行反馈指导进一步更新。我们的实验涵盖 Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro 和 ProgramBench，使用带有 Codex 的 GPT-5.5 和带有 Claude Code 的 GLM-5.2。在这些使用 GPT-5.5 和 Codex 的基准测试中，相对于 RHO，HarnessPro 的重型模式实现了 2.0 个百分点的平均通过率提升和 26.1% 的平均每任务成本降低。当 GLM-5.2 与 Claude Code 一起使用时，advantage 也成立。代码可在 https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro 获取

stories.title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
stories.summary: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.
stories.titleZh: SWIFT：通过目标外推的自引导弱到强扩散模型
stories.summaryZh: 训练高质量扩散模型的计算成本很高，并且推理时间指导通常会进一步增加采样成本。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 Swift，这是一种简单而有效的自引导训练方法，它使用冻结的弱降噪器来改进更强的模型，而无需增加推理开销。对于每个噪声输入，Swift 都会从弱降噪器的预测中推断出干净的回归目标，从而放大仍然欠拟合的组件。弱引导可以是早期训练的 checkpoint，在主模型训练期间不需要反向传播，然后被丢弃。生成的模型保留了原始采样器，并支持条件和无条件生成，无需标签丢失或无条件分支。我们通过 RKHS 中有限时间群体梯度流的谱分析来解释这一机制。通过提前停止的弱引导，我们证明了外推强度的非空范围产生的后验均值误差严格低于匹配的标准训练，尽管回归目标远离后验均值。 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-256 上的实验证明了模型规模和表示方面的改进。在一种 ImageNet-256 配置中，Swift 使用大约一半的总训练计算（包括指南准备和训练开销）超越了基线的最佳 FID。在 RAEv2 上，它在没有推理时间指导的情况下达到了 FID 1.15，在有指导的情况下达到了 0.99。这些结果确立了目标外推法作为一种有效的方法，通过有效的单模型推理进行从弱到强的扩散训练。

stories.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
stories.summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon
stories.titleZh: 无需语言预训练的文本到图像生成建模
stories.summaryZh: 现代文本到图像（T2I）系统使用互联网规模的语言预训练来生成文本条件图像。我们询问语言预训练对于强大的 T2I 生成是否是必要的。我们介绍了 Halcyon，这是一系列早期融合多模态自回归模型，完全在 GPIC（一个包含 1 亿个图像文本对的数据集）上从头开始进行预训练。 Halcyon-0.52B 的性能优于 LlamaGen-XL/8（48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD），预训练计算量减少了 18.2$\times$。此外，Halcyon-1.6B 的性能优于 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++（35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD），预训练计算量减少了 275$\times$。对照实验表明，纯文本预训练并不能改善 T2I 的生成。 Halcyon 还通过用 I2T 监督替换字幕丢失来学习图像字幕，在相同的预训练预算下保持有竞争力的 T2I 生成质量。我们证明，强大的 T2I 系统可以从头开始训练，无需进行互联网规模的语言预训练。代码和模型可在 https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon 获取
