stories.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
stories.summary: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions. A central design question is whether to retain only observed trajectories and outcomes or also the rules, summaries, and skills inferred from them. Retaining these abstractions allows agents to reuse strategies without repeatedly deriving them from raw trajectories. However, errors in stored abstractions can propagate to subsequent decisions through retrieval and reuse. They can also shape execution trajectories, which then become the basis for new abstractions that reproduce the original errors. We term this feedback mechanism error reproduction: errors are regenerated through a cycle of abstraction, execution, and re-abstraction, extending their persistence beyond direct reuse of the original faulty knowledge. We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand. An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance, which is discarded after execution. This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible. Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.
stories.titleZh: 内存越大，代理越差：LLM 代理中的错误再现和反持久性
stories.summaryZh: LLM 代理可以通过将自己执行的经验存储在外部存储器中并重用它来指导以后的决策，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下改进任务。一个中心设计问题是是否只保留观察到的轨迹和结果，或者还保留从中推断出的规则、摘要和技能。保留这些抽象允许代理重用策略，而无需重复从原始轨迹中导出策略。然而，存储的抽象中的错误可能会通过检索和重用传播到后续决策。它们还可以塑造执行轨迹，然后成为重现原始错误的新抽象的基础。我们将这种反馈机制称为错误再现：错误通过抽象、执行和重新抽象的循环重新生成，将其持久性扩展到直接重用原始错误知识之外。我们提出了反持久性，这是一种记忆设计，可以积累轨迹和结果，同时根据需要重建特定于任务的指导。自适应选择器使用先前的结果来决定是否以及如何合成指导，这些指导在执行后被丢弃。尽管通过保留的轨迹进行间接反馈仍然是可能的，但这阻止了它作为存储对象的直接重用。在不同的基准和主干上，反持久性在评估的内存设计中实现了更高的总体保留成功率和最低的平均 LLM 调用成本。这些结果支持在基于记忆的自我完善中将经验积累与抽象持久性分开。

stories.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
stories.summary: OpenDS-World introduces a live-web benchmark to evaluate autonomous multi-step deep search agents, revealing significant gaps between frontier models and human performance.
stories.titleZh: 真实网络环境中的深度搜索
stories.summaryZh: OpenDS-World 引入了实时网络基准来评估自主多步深度搜索代理，揭示了前沿模型与人类表现之间的显着差距。

stories.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
stories.summary: A heartbeat-style speculative reasoning approach lets voice agents continue preparing tool calls during speech updates, improving coverage and reducing response latency.
stories.titleZh: 心跳思维：实时语音代理监听时的推测推理和工具执行
stories.summaryZh: 心跳式推测推理方法让语音代理在语音更新期间继续准备工具调用，从而提高覆盖范围并减少响应 latency。

stories.title: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
stories.summary: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.
stories.titleZh: 谁带头？模型能力和任务条件下的人类协作
stories.summaryZh: 研究人员使用共享控制迷宫表明，更强大的语言模型代理会根据 advantage 路线选择性地让人类参与，而不是不合作。

stories.title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
stories.summary: CoworkEnv synthesizes executable training environments for AI coworkers using workflow-guided task construction and programmatic validation, enabling supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of compact PocketWorker models that improve multi-turn coordination and tool use.
stories.titleZh: CoworkEnv：为长期协同工作代理综合培训环境
stories.summaryZh: CoworkEnv 使用工作流程引导的任务构建和编程验证为 AI 同事合成可执行的培训环境，支持监督 fine-tuning 和紧凑 PocketWorker 模型的强化学习，从而改善多轮协调和工具使用。

stories.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
stories.summary: MT Forcing improves multi-turn image editing by combining single-turn distribution matching distillation and teacher-forcing guidance to stabilize visual quality and preserve cross-turn consistency.
stories.titleZh: MT 强制：通过自回归扩散实现稳定一致的多轮图像编辑
stories.summaryZh: MT Forcing 通过结合单轮分布匹配蒸馏和教师强制指导来改进多轮图像编辑，以稳定视觉质量并保持交叉轮一致性。

stories.title: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
stories.summary: TCoVP introduces a spatiotemporally grounded video reasoning chain that links entities to timestamped visual evidence for segmentation, improving reasoning and mask prediction across benchmarks.
stories.titleZh: 跨越空间和时间的视觉思考：视频分割的基础推理
stories.summaryZh: TCoVP 引入了一个时空基础的视频推理链，将实体与带有时间戳的视觉证据联系起来以进行分割，从而改进跨基准的推理和掩模预测。

stories.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
stories.summary: AffordanceWAM uses affordance representations from human videos to jointly predict future scenes and robot actions, improving manipulation transfer without human action labels.
stories.titleZh: AffordanceWAM：用于机器人操作的可供感知联合世界动作建模
stories.summaryZh: AffordanceWAM 使用人类视频中的可供性表示来共同预测未来场景和机器人动作，从而在没有人类动作标签的情况下改进操作转移。

stories.title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
stories.summary: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.
stories.titleZh: 政策不是能力：一些安全基准衡量您接受培训的“不安全”的定义
stories.summaryZh: 据报告，护栏分类器好像不安全是文本的属性。它不是：它是策略的属性，策略通过其标签进入模型。我们利用了一次工业部署事故，其中相同的约 53k 提示在两个操作定义下被标记了两次（“这是对有害内容的请求吗？”和“主持人会阻止这个吗？”），并用于在两个模型规模上训练十个护栏臂共享架构、代码库和优化器系列。首先，guardrail 自己的训练语料库已经包含了基准：训练池中存在 JailbreakBench-benign 为 88%，OR-Bench-hard 为 82%，这是两个过度拒绝基准，guardrail 报告称它不会过度阻止。下面的所有东西都经过消毒。其次，安全基准的得分很大程度上取决于标签定义而不是模型：在架构和优化器固定的情况下，十个分支的范围在 HarmBench 版权上为 0.99，在 WildGuard 良性上为 0.043，相差 23 倍。第三，基准分数可以在整个范围内移动 0.03% 的参数。在这些臂中，HarmBench-版权跨度为 0-100，OR-Bench-hard 过度拒绝为 3.4-56.4%，并且最后一个监督信号携带给定策略的四个臂占据两者的一个极端（精确排名 p=0.005，或最坏的 0.04-0.14），检测能力不变。对于一个精炼的学生来说，即使每个硬标签都带有其他策略，教师的软标签也会这样做，因此教师的出处在任何发布的 checkpoint 中都是一个未记录的混乱。第四，对所有 20 个臂进行评分的一个分割的验证准确性与注释者策略的一致性 (rho=+0.74)，而不是检测能力 (rho=+0.34)。我们认为，护栏评估应该报告污染、种子层以及它们分级的定义作为一流变量。

stories.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
stories.summary: StopLoss is a lightweight external monitor that predicts coding-agent failures from recent tool steps to abort doomed runs early, reducing compute costs while preserving successful outcomes.
stories.titleZh: 止损：教导代理预测失败并尽早停止
stories.summaryZh: StopLoss 是一种轻量级外部监视器，可以根据最近的工具步骤预测编码代理故障，从而尽早中止注定的运行，从而降低计算成本，同时保留成功的结果。

stories.title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
stories.summary: VLA-Rolling improves vision-language-action model efficiency by reusing discarded action tails with adaptive denoising budgets, reducing inference cost and boosting success rates.
stories.titleZh: VLA-Rolling：更少的去噪步骤，通过自适应动作重用更好的控制
stories.summaryZh: VLA-Rolling 通过利用自适应去噪预算重用废弃的动作尾部来提高视觉-语言-动作模型的效率，降低推理成本并提高成功率。

stories.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
stories.summary: Deep Fusion Memory integrates predicted parametric memory into intermediate hidden states via gated cross-attention, reducing retrieval overhead and improving knowledge-intensive tasks without online retrieval.
stories.titleZh: 深度融合存储器：用于大型语言模型的块级参数存储器
stories.summaryZh: 深度融合记忆通过门控交叉注意力将预测的参数记忆集成到中间隐藏状态中，减少检索开销并改进知识密集型任务，而无需在线检索。

stories.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
stories.summary: TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.
stories.titleZh: TILDE：教师在环中从具体基础模型中进行蒸馏
stories.summaryZh: TILDE 通过策略教师监督和自主恢复数据收集将基础模型功能提炼到机器人策略中，无需大规模动作预训练即可提高现实世界的任务性能。

stories.title: UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling
stories.summary: UniAVC trains separate audio and video branches on abundant unimodal data before aligning them with scarce paired data, using independent noise schedules and asymmetric supervision to enable joint synthesis, cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing.
stories.titleZh: UniAVC：通过渐进式训练和不对称调度进行统一音视频创建
stories.summaryZh: UniAVC 在丰富的单模态数据上训练单独的音频和视频分支，然后将它们与稀缺的配对数据对齐，使用独立的噪声调度和不对称监督来实现联合合成、跨模态生成和指令引导编辑。

stories.title: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
stories.summary: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.
stories.titleZh: EdgeKernelBench：边缘后端统一 LLM 驱动的内核生成
stories.summaryZh: 最近的研究表明，LLM 可以在服务器 GPU 上生成具有强大性能的内核。由于硬件异构、软件堆栈分散且资源预算紧张，边缘部署面临着明显的挑战。跨不同边缘后端的 LLM 内核生成尚未得到系统研究。我们推出 EdgeKernelBench，它将统一的 IR 部署框架与边缘工作负载的分层基准相结合。统一的 IR 捕获可重用的计算、调度和内存决策，并通过编译器接口连接到每个目标后端。该基准测试涵盖了逐渐扩大的程序范围，从单个操作员到紧凑的模型图，跨越代表性的边缘应用程序领域。我们使用 TVM 作为参考编译器实例化设计，并在异构边缘后端对其进行验证。通过单代尝试，最好的模型达到了 64.5% Correct@1，但只有 25.5% Fast@1.0。这一差距表明功能正确性并不能始终如一地转化为性能提升。因此，我们引入了分层边缘内核代理 (LEKA)，它通过分层 IR 组织优化。在代理评估子集上，LEKA 在 Fast@1.0 上实现了 43.5%，而直接生成为 13.0%，Claude Code 为 26.1%。 LEKA 和 Claude Code 使用相同的基础模型和优化预算。 EdgeKernelBench 和 LEKA 共同支持跨边缘后端的 LLM 生成的内核的统一评估和分层优化。

stories.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
stories.summary: Progress-Aware Distillation detects and penalizes stagnation in distilled small language model agents to improve reasoning efficiency and success rates.
stories.titleZh: 用于缓解小语言模型代理停滞的进度感知蒸馏
stories.summaryZh: 进度感知蒸馏检测并惩罚蒸馏小语言模型代理中的停滞，以提高推理效率和成功率。

stories.title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
stories.summary: HybridResearcher is a small agent trained via synthetic cross-source trajectories and reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured data, outperforming much larger models without forgetting single-source skills.
stories.titleZh: HybridResearcher：弥合深度研究代理的结构化与非结构化边界
stories.summaryZh: HybridResearcher 是一个小型代理，通过合成跨源轨迹和强化学习进行训练，可以对结构化和非结构化数据进行推理，在不忘记单源技能的情况下超越更大的模型。

stories.title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
stories.summary: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.
stories.titleZh: 连接探索和角色：测试时代理个性化的信息导向决斗
stories.summaryZh: ID-TAP 使用具有相似性加权热启动的神经决斗强盗框架，通过有限交互预算内的二元响应比较来使 LLM 代理适应用户偏好。

stories.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
stories.summary: IF-MAP identifies high-impact agents in multi-agent LLM systems via prompt perturbation analysis to maximize system-level gains from targeted improvements.
stories.titleZh: IF-MAP：多智能体系统中受影响函数启发的智能体优先级排序
stories.summaryZh: IF-MAP 通过即时扰动分析识别多代理 LLM 系统中的高影响力代理，以最大限度地提高有针对性的改进所带来的系统级收益。

stories.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
stories.summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.
stories.titleZh: OR-License：将法学硕士代理人评估为现实世界的运筹学从业者
stories.summaryZh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理能否直接根据原始客户材料提供专家级运筹学 (OR) 解决方案，而无需事先由专家重新制定？现有的 OR 基准通常从独立的描述或预定义的优化任务开始，不足以将原始业务材料转化为经过专业验证的解决方案。我们推出了 OR-License，这是一项端到端基准测试，涉及 10 个工业场景中的 31 个实例，其中付费 OR 业务总额达 368 万美元。它在去标识化后保留了原始需求、输入数据、可交付格式和信息边界。为了研究信息获取，我们引入了 ORSim，这是一种受控客户端模拟器，可以在不提供 OR 专业知识的情况下披露业务事实。隐藏评估在基准构建之前检查可行性并将客观质量与客户接受的原始专家解决方案进行比较。部署调整质量 (DAQ) 跨实例平均专家相对质量，将零分配给不可行的交付。在使用编码代理工具的 11 个前沿法学硕士中，有几个在条件客观质量方面超过了专家参考，但没有一个与其 DAQ 相匹配；最强的 Claude Code 主要配置可实现 88.39% 的严格可行性和 0.87 的 DAQ（相对于专家参考 1）。客户信息获取不仅限于澄清，还延伸到解决方案开发和验证，某些后期阶段显示出更高的已确认问题解决比例。轨迹分析可识别制定和实施失败，而可评估任务模型的任务均衡研究链完成率范围为 24% 至 45%。这些发现激发了可靠的长期代理人持续的信息差距解决、忠实的问题表述以及与证据相关的自我完善。

stories.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
stories.summary: Self-HPO is a recursive framework that alternates harness and policy optimization for coding agents, improving performance by targeting evolving failure modes through reinforcement learning.
stories.titleZh: 通过 Harness 策略优化的自我进化编码代理
stories.summaryZh: Self-HPO 是一个递归框架，它替代了 harness 和编码代理的策略优化，通过强化学习针对不断变化的故障模式来提高性能。

stories.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
stories.summary: MARS enables multimodal safety steering using only text-derived refusal directions, avoiding the need for multimodal safety data.
stories.titleZh: 利用短信拒绝指示实现多式联运安全
stories.summaryZh: MARS 仅使用文本衍生的拒绝指示即可实现多模式安全转向，从而无需多模式安全数据。

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.summary: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
stories.titleZh: 混合推理代理
stories.summaryZh: 我们如何才能构建一个超越人类语言思考、但仍能在外部环境中通过人类语言行动的智能体？现代 LLM 代理仍然通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理提供了有效的内部媒介，但缺乏本地工具访问和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理代理（HybridAgents）将这两个方向联系起来，它在整个统一的生成过程中动态地在潜在推理和基于文本的交互之间导航。从架构上讲，轻量级 HybridLink 可实现文本模式和潜在模式之间的无缝转换，而代理的连续工作记忆可在多个回合中保留无损混合上下文。这些设计保留了工具集成的 agentic 功能，同时使潜在的想法可以直接检查。在此架构的基础上，我们进一步开发了用于混合推理的专用后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过教导骨干网与 HybridLink 协调来稳定工具集成的混合生成，然后 HybridRL 通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考以及何时通过文本采取行动来扩展推理。我们在 11 个基准的 3 个模型尺度上评估 HybridAgent，涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和 agentic 推理。与涵盖基于文本和潜在方法的前沿 LLM Agent 和 agentic 框架相比，HybridAgent 始终将性能提高了 10.4%，同时减少了 35.5%-54.7% 的令牌，推理速度提高了 1.8x-2.6 倍，并节省了 2.7x-3.7 倍的成本。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent 获取。

stories.title: Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
stories.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\times$ and $4.14\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.
stories.titleZh: 扩散起草的 Speculative Decoding 的因式分解引导训练和推理
stories.summaryZh: Speculative decoding 通过并行验证起草者提出的标记来加速大型语言模型推理。扩散起草者进一步并行化提案生成，但更大的提案容量或更高的平均接受代币（MAT）不一定会产生更高的 throughput。由于验证仅接受连续前缀，因此早期拒绝可能会使以后的正确预测无效，从而限制 MAT 增益，而如果每轮 latency 增加，即使更高的 MAT 也可能不会改善 throughput。我们引入了 DScout，它使用两个互补分解来指导扩散起草器训练和更高 throughput 的推理。对于训练，DScout 将位置损失分解为包含损失、加权损失和预测损失。这指导了混合水平训练、块内揭露和接受加权损失的设计和组合，以使监督与前缀接受保持一致并改进 MAT。对于推理，DScout 将 throughput 分解为 MAT 与每轮 latency 的比率，指导目标调节深度、绘图深度和推理块大小选择，以确定每个工作负载的高 throughput 配置。在六个基准测试中，DScout 比 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上的自回归解码分别实现了 3.84\times$ 和 $4.14\times$ 平均加速，与最先进的基线相比平均加速提高了 9.1% 和 7.1%。在模型和并发设置中，我们的推理配置策略比 DScout 的固定配置提供高达 9.75% 的额外平均加速。
